systems.system: civil registry system (digitisation plan under Amecc, with a Personal Identification Number)
systems.owner: Government of Comoros through the Amecc programme; funded by the French Embassy, UNICEF technical support
systems.tiers: nationwide plan; preparatory studies validated in Moroni on 25 March 2026; municipalities support it; largely manual per a 2022 assessment

note: Reports validation of the civil registry digitisation studies; says the study assessed existing infrastructure and that digital maturity is uneven across the islands, with no statement on any municipality's connection.
